description.value:
Traits Signal

Your Crescendo requires 4 Encore rather than 5, and after it resolves your Encore pool is 1 rather than 0. You may Crescendo at exactly 4 Encore, spending 3 of them. Everything else about Crescendo is unchanged: 1 action, every ally in range gains one Standing Reroll, and it lasts 1 minute. The retained point is ordinary Encore — an ally may spend it immediately, and it is lost when your Broadcast ends like any other.
